Product brand system

FIHAN

Give good work a clear introduction.

The starting point

Give good work a clear introduction.

A product demonstration can show every screen and still leave someone wondering what the product does. FIHAN’s identity needed the same discipline as a good walkthrough: frame the useful part, guide attention and let the work make its case.

The work covered

  • Positioning and personality
  • Reveal emblem and wordmark system
  • Colour, type and product icons
  • Voice, messaging and motion guidance

The decisions

A reason for
the choices.

The Reveal emblem combines an F with an open corner. That opening carries through the framing, iconography and motion guidance. Signal Blue draws attention; Midnight gives the interface room to breathe.

  • #4D6BFF
  • #0B1020
  • #BCEBFF
  • #F5F7FC

The words

Show the work.

Three words that give the brand a job. The supporting line, ‘Give your product a walkthrough people can follow,’ explains the benefit before the mechanism.
